modules.title: Present Simple — Oddiy hozirgi zamon
modules.video_title: Present Simple — English Grammar (eng yaxshi tushuntirish)
modules.theory: Present Simple nima uchun ishlatiladi? 1. Odatlar va rutinlar: I wake up at 7 every day. 2. Faktlar va umumiy haqiqatlar: The sun rises in the east. 3. Jadvallar: The train leaves at 9. Qanday yasash: • I / You / We / They + V1 → I work • He / She / It + V1 + s/es → She works Inkor: don't / doesn't + V1 Savol: Do / Does + subject + V1? 💡 Eslatma: -s/-es faqat 3-shaxs birlikda qo'shiladi!
modules.theory_oral: Present Simple — oddiy hozirgi zamon. U odatlar, faktlar va jadvallar uchun ishlatiladi. Men, sen, biz, ular bilan fe'l o'zgarmaydi. U, u (qiz), u (narsa) bilan fe'lga -s yoki -es qo'shiladi. Inkor uchun don't yoki doesn't, savol uchun Do yoki Does ishlatiladi.

modules.title: Present Continuous — Davomiy hozirgi zamon
modules.video_title: Present Continuous — now va at the moment
modules.theory: Present Continuous (am/is/are + V-ing) 1. Hozir sodir bo'layotgan harakat: I am reading now. 2. Vaqtincha holat: She is living in Tashkent this month. 3. Kelajak rejalari (yaqin): We are meeting tomorrow. Yasalishi: • I am working • He/She/It is working • You/We/They are working ❌ Statik fe'llar (know, like, want, need...) odatda Continuous'da kelmaydi!
modules.theory_oral: Present Continuous — hozir davom etayotgan harakatlar uchun. Am, is yoki are + fe'lning -ing shakli. Masalan: I am studying. Statik fe'llar — bilmoq, yoqtirmoq kabilar — bu zamonda kam ishlatiladi.

modules.title: Past Simple — Oddiy o'tgan zamon
modules.video_title: Past Simple — regular va irregular verbs
modules.theory: Past Simple — o'tgan zamonda tugagan harakatlar. • Regular: V + ed → worked, played • Irregular: go→went, see→saw, have→had Inkor: didn't + V1 Savol: Did + subject + V1? Vaqt belgilari: yesterday, last week, in 2020, ago
modules.theory_oral: Past Simple — o'tgan zamonda bo'lib o'tgan va tugagan ishlar. Regular fe'llarga -ed qo'shiladi. Irregular fe'llar esa o'ziga xos shakl oladi: go — went, see — saw. Inkor va savolda did ishlatiladi, fe'l asosiy shaklda qoladi.

modules.title: Future Simple & Going to
modules.video_title: Will vs Going to — kelajak zamonlari
modules.theory: Will + V1: • Spontán qarorlar: I'll help you! • Bashoratlar: It will rain. • Va'dalar: I will call you. Be going to + V1: • Oldindan rejalashtirilgan: I'm going to study medicine. • Aniq belgilari bor bashorat: Look at those clouds — it's going to rain. Ikkalasi ham kelajakni bildiradi, lekin kontekst farq qiladi.
modules.theory_oral: Will — birdan qaror qilganda, va'da berishda yoki umumiy bashoratda. Going to — oldindan reja qilingan ishlar yoki aniq belgilarga asoslangan bashoratda ishlatiladi.

modules.title: Present Perfect
modules.theory: Present Perfect = have/has + V3 (Past Participle) 1. Hayotiy tajriba: I have been to Japan. 2. Hozirgacha davom etgan: She has lived here since 2015. 3. Yaqinda sodir bo'lgan, natijasi bor: I have lost my keys (hali topmadim). Belgilari: ever, never, just, already, yet, since, for
modules.theory_oral: Present Perfect — o'tgan bilan hozirni bog'laydi. Have yoki has + fe'lning uchinchi shakli. Tajriba, hozirgacha davom etgan ish yoki natijasi bor yaqin o'tgan uchun ishlatiladi.

modules.title: Present Perfect Continuous — Hozirgi tugallangan davomiy zamon
modules.theory: Present Perfect Continuous (PPC) 1. Yasalishi: • Darak: S + have/has been + V-ing → She has been studying for 2 hours. • Inkor: S + haven't/hasn't been + V-ing → We haven't been sleeping well lately. • So'roq: Have/Has + S + been + V-ing? → Have you been waiting long? 2. Qo'llanilishi: ① O'tmishda boshlanib, hozirgacha davom etayotgan harakat (davomiylik urg'ulanadi): I have been learning English for three years. ② Yaqinda tugagan, lekin natijasi ko'rinib turgan harakat: You look tired. Have you been running? ③ Takrorlanib turayotgan harakat (all day, this week bilan): He has been calling her all morning. 3. Signal so'zlar: for, since, all day/week/morning, lately, recently, how long 4. Present Perfect bilan farqi: • PPC — jarayon va davomiylik: I have been reading this book for a week. (hali o'qiyapman) • Present Perfect — natija va tugallanish: I have read three books this month. (bajarildi) • Miqdor/sanoq bo'lsa PPC ishlatilmaydi: She has written five letters. (NOT has been writing) 5. Muhim istisno — state (holat) fe'llari: know, like, love, believe, understand, want, remember bilan PPC ishlatilmaydi: I have known him for five years. (NOT: have been knowing)
modules.theory_oral: Present Perfect Continuous — harakat o'tmishda boshlangan, hozirgacha davom etayotgan yoki yaqindagina tugagan bo'lsa ishlatiladi. Yasalishi: have yoki has, keyin been, keyin fe'lning ing shakli. Asosiy signal so'zlar: for, since, all day, lately, recently. Bu zamon jarayonni ko'rsatadi; agar natija yoki miqdor aytilsa, Present Simple Perfect ishlatiladi. State fe'llar — know, like, believe — bilan bu zamon ishlatilmaydi.

modules.title: Past Perfect — Oldindan o'tgan zamon
modules.theory: Past Perfect (Past Simple'dan oldingi o'tmish) 1. Yasalishi: • Darak: S + had + V3 → The film had already started. • Inkor: S + hadn't + V3 → I hadn't finished my homework. • So'roq: Had + S + V3? → Had they left before you arrived? Barcha shaxslar uchun bir xil: had. 2. Qo'llanilishi: ① O'tmishdagi bir harakatdan oldinroq sodir bo'lgan harakat: When I arrived at the station, the train had left. (avval poyezd ketdi → keyin men keldim) ② 'By the time' / 'before' / 'after' bilan ketma-ketlik: By the time we got home, it had stopped raining. ③ O'tmishda tajriba (hech qachon ... qilmagan edi): It was the best meal I had ever eaten. 3. Signal so'zlar: by the time, before, after, already, just, never ... until, when, by 5 o'clock 4. Past Simple bilan taqqoslash: • Ketma-ket harakatlar (birin-ketin) → Past Simple: I woke up, washed my face and left. • Biri oldinroq bo'lsa → oldingisi Past Perfect: She had cooked dinner before her husband came. 5. Tipik xato: 'When' bilan ikkala harakat ham ketma-ket bo'lsa, Past Perfect shart emas: When he finished work, he went home. (oddiy ketma-ketlik)
modules.theory_oral: Past Perfect — o'tmishdagi bir voqeadan oldinroq sodir bo'lgan harakatni bildiradi. Yasalishi: had va fe'lning uchinchi shakli, barcha shaxslar uchun bir xil. Asosiy signal so'zlar: by the time, before, after, already. Misol: When I arrived, the train had left — avval poyezd ketgan, keyin men yetib borganman.

modules.title: Future Continuous, Future Perfect & Future Perfect Continuous
modules.video_title: Future Continuous & Future Perfect — video dars
modules.theory: A. Future Continuous (Kelasi davomiy zamon) Yasalishi: S + will be + V-ing • At 8 pm tomorrow I will be flying to London. • Inkor: won't be + V-ing · So'roq: Will + S + be + V-ing? Qo'llanilishi: ① Kelajakdagi aniq vaqtda jarayonda bo'ladigan harakat: This time next week we will be lying on the beach. ② Xushmuomalalik so'rog'i (rejangizni so'rash): Will you be using the car tonight? Signal so'zlar: at this time tomorrow, this time next week, at 8 pm, all day tomorrow —————— B. Future Perfect (Kelasi tugallangan zamon) Yasalishi: S + will have + V3 • By 2030 scientists will have found a cure. • Inkor: won't have + V3 · So'roq: Will + S + have + V3? Qo'llanilishi: Kelajakdagi ma'lum nuqtaga qadar tugallanadigan harakat: By the time you arrive, I will have finished the report. Signal so'zlar: by, by the time, by next year, by 5 o'clock, before —————— Taqqoslash: • Future Continuous — jarayon: At 9 I will be having breakfast. (9 da nonushta qilayotgan bo'laman) • Future Perfect — natija: By 9 I will have had breakfast. (9 gacha nonushtani tugatgan bo'laman) —————— C. Future Perfect Continuous Yasalishi: S + will have been + V-ing • By 2027 I will have been teaching for twenty years. Qo'llanilishi: Kelajakdagi ma'lum nuqtaga qadar qancha vaqt davom etgan bo'ladi: In March we will have been living here for five years. Signal so'zlar: by, for + davr, by the end of, by the time Uch zamonni taqqoslash: • At 9 pm I will be watching TV. (jarayon) • By 9 pm I will have watched two films. (natija) • By 9 pm I will have been watching TV for three hours. (davomiylik)
modules.theory_oral: Future Continuous — kelajakdagi aniq vaqtda jarayonda bo'ladigan harakat: will be va fe'lning ing shakli. Future Perfect — kelajakdagi ma'lum nuqtaga qadar tugallanadigan harakat: will have va fe'lning uchinchi shakli. Asosiy signal so'z: by — gacha, qadar degan ma'noni beradi va Future Perfect bilan ishlatiladi.

modules.title: Modal verbs — Qo'shimcha fe'llar (can, must, should...)
modules.theory: Modal verbs — qo'shimcha fe'llar Modal fe'llar harakatga munosabat bildiradi: imkoniyat, majburiyat, ruxsat, maslahat, ehtimol. Umumiy qoida: modal + V1 (infinitiv, 'to'siz). Ular -s, -ing, -ed olmaydi. She can swim. He must go. (NOT: cans, musts) 1. Imkoniyat (ability): • can — hozirgi: I can speak English. • could — o'tmishdagi: She could run fast when she was young. • be able to — boshqa zamonlarda: You will be able to enter tomorrow. 2. Ruxsat (permission): can (norasmiy), may (rasmiy) May I come in? You can use my phone. 3. Majburiyat (obligation): • must — ichki majburiyat, kuchli: I must finish this today. • have to — tashqi qoida/majburiyat: We have to wear a uniform. • mustn't = taqiq (mumkin emas): You mustn't smoke here. • don't have to = shart emas: You don't have to come early. ⚠️ mustn't va don't have to — butunlay boshqa ma'no! 4. Maslahat (advice): should / ought to You should see a doctor. You ought to rest. 5. Ehtimol (possibility): may, might, could (50% → 30%) He might be late. It could rain. 6. Xulosa (deduction): • must — 90% ishonch: He isn't answering. He must be asleep. • can't — imkonsiz degan xulosa: That can't be true!
modules.theory_oral: Modal fe'llar harakatga munosabat bildiradi va doim fe'lning birinchi shakli bilan ishlatiladi. Can — imkoniyat, may — ruxsat, must — kuchli majburiyat, have to — tashqi qoida, should — maslahat, might — ehtimol. Eng muhim farq: mustn't — taqiq, don't have to esa — shart emas degan ma'noni bildiradi.

exercises.question: You ___ touch this wire — it's dangerous! (taqiq)
exercises.explanation: Qat'iy taqiq → mustn't. 'don't have to' — shart emas, degan ma'no.

exercises.question: Tomorrow is Sunday. You ___ get up early. (shart emas)
You look ill. You ___ see a doctor. (maslahat)
exercises.explanation: Maslahat → should + V1. Modallardan keyin 'to' qo'yilmaydi.

exercises.question: ___ I use your phone, please? (rasmiy ruxsat so'rash)
exercises.explanation: Rasmiy ruxsat → May I...? (Can/Could ham mumkin, kamroq rasmiy.)

exercises.question: When I was five, I ___ already read.
He's not answering his phone. He ___ be asleep.
She's been studying all day. She ___ be tired.
That ___ be Sarah — she's in London right now!
exercises.explanation: Imkonsiz degan xulosa → can't. (mustn't — taqiq, xulosa emas.)

exercises.question: Students ___ wear a uniform at this school — it's a rule. (tashqi qoida)
exercises.explanation: Maktab qoidasi (tashqi majburiyat) → have to; must ham qabul qilinadi.

exercises.question: Take an umbrella — it ___ rain later.
Qaysi gap TO'G'RI?
exercises.explanation: 'Ought' doim 'to' bilan: ought to + V1. Must/should dan keyin 'to' qo'yilmaydi.

exercises.question: I ___ finish the report yesterday, but I ran out of time.

modules.title: Conditionals (0 & 1)
modules.theory: Zero Conditional (umumiy haqiqat): If + Present Simple, Present Simple If you heat water, it boils. First Conditional (real kelajak): If + Present Simple, will + V1 If it rains, I will stay home.
modules.theory_oral: Zero Conditional — doimo rost bo'lgan narsalar uchun. First Conditional — kelajakda mumkin bo'lgan shart va uning natijasi uchun. If qismida Present, asosiy qismida will.

exercises.question: If it rains, I ___ stay home.
If you ___ water to 100°C, it boils.
If she studies hard, she ___ (pass) the exam.
If you don't water plants, they ___.
If it ___ (be) sunny tomorrow, we will go to the park.
If I ___ time, I will help you.
Ice ___ if you heat it.
If she ___ (call), tell her I'm busy.
We ___ miss the bus if we don't hurry.
If you mix red and blue, you ___ purple.
If he studies, he ___ (pass).

modules.title: Second Conditional — Ikkinchi shartli gap
modules.theory: Second Conditional — hozirgi/kelasi haqidagi xayoliy shart 1. Yasalishi: If + Past Simple, ... would + V1 If I had more time, I would travel the world. Bog'lovchi o'rtada ham kelishi mumkin: I would travel the world if I had more time. 2. Qo'llanilishi: ① Hozirgi yoki kelajakdagi noreal / xayoliy vaziyat: If I won the lottery, I would buy a house. (lekin yutmayman) ② Maslahat berish: If I were you, I would... If I were you, I would apologize. ⚠️ Rasmiy tilda 'I' bilan ham were ishlatiladi (was emas). 3. First Conditional bilan farqi: • 1st — real ehtimol: If it rains, I will stay home. (yomg'ir yog'ishi mumkin) • 2nd — xayoliy: If it rained money, I would be rich. (bu hech qachon bo'lmaydi) 4. Variantlar: • would o'rniga: could, might If I spoke French, I could work in Paris. • Inkor: wouldn't + V1 If I knew the answer, I wouldn't be silent. 5. Tipik xatolar: • If-qismida 'would' ishlatilmaydi: If I would have... → If I had... • 'were' barcha shaxslar bilan: If he was rich → If he were rich (rasmiy)
modules.theory_oral: Second Conditional — hozirgi yoki kelajakdagi noreal, xayoliy vaziyatlar uchun ishlatiladi. Yasalishi: If va Past Simple, keyin would va fe'lning birinchi shakli. Eng mashhur ibora: If I were you — senning o'rningda bo'lganimda. If-qismida would ishlatilmaydi, bu eng ko'p uchraydigan xato.

exercises.question: If I ___ rich, I would help my village.
exercises.explanation: Second Conditional: If + Past Simple. 'I' bilan rasmiy shakl — were.

exercises.question: If she studied harder, she ___ the exam.
If I (be) ___ you, I would tell the truth.
exercises.explanation: If I were you — maslahat beruvchi barqaror ibora.

exercises.question: We ___ around the world if we had enough money.
If I ___ his number, I could call him.
Qaysi gap TO'G'RI?
options: If I lived in London, I would visit museums every week.
If I would live in London, I visited museums.
If I live in London, I would visit museums.
If I lived in London, I will visit museums.
exercises.explanation: If-qismida would bo'lmaydi; natija qismi would + V1.

exercises.question: If it ___ snow, we would go skiing. (lekin qor yog'ishi dargumon)
He wouldn't be late if he (leave) ___ earlier.
If I had wings, I ___ to school every day.
exercises.explanation: would o'rniga could ham ishlatiladi; 'would flying' — grammatik xato.

exercises.question: I ___ a new laptop if I saved enough money.
What ___ if you lost your job?
exercises.explanation: Xayoliy savol → What would you do...?

exercises.question: If everyone ___ honest, the world would be a better place.
exercises.explanation: Noreal vaziyat, 'everyone' bilan rasmiy shakl — were.

modules.title: Passive Voice (asoslari)
modules.theory: Passive = be (is/are/was/were...) + V3 Active: Millions of people read the book. Passive: The book was read by millions of people. Ijrochi muhim bo'lmasa yoki noma'lum bo'lsa ishlatiladi.
modules.theory_oral: Passive Voice — harakatni bajaruvchi emas, harakatning o'zi muhim bo'lganda. Be fe'li + fe'lning uchinchi shakli. Masalan: The house was built in 1990.

exercises.question: The book ___ by millions of people.
This house was built ___ 1990.
English ___ (speak) all over the world.
This letter ___ yesterday.
Rice ___ (grow) in many countries.
The windows ___ cleaned every week.
Active: 'Someone stole my bike.' Passive:
The film ___ (direct) by Nolan.
Spanish ___ in many countries.
The results ___ announced tomorrow.
This song ___ (write) in 1990.

modules.title: Third Conditional & Wish
modules.theory: Third Conditional (o'tgan haqida afsus): If + Past Perfect, would have + V3 If I had known, I would have acted differently. Inversiya: Had I known, I would have... Wish + Past Perfect — o'tgan haqida afsus: I wish I had had more time yesterday.
modules.theory_oral: Third Conditional — o'tgan zamonda boshqacha bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan narsalar haqida. If + had + V3, would have + V3. Wish bilan ham o'tgan uchun Past Perfect ishlatiladi.

exercises.question: Had I known earlier, I ___ differently.
I wish I ___ more time yesterday.
If she had studied, she ___ (pass) the test.
If I had known, I ___ come earlier.
I wish I ___ (not / say) that.
If she had left earlier, she ___ the train.
I wish it ___ raining. (now)
Had we known, we ___ (change) our plans.
She wishes she ___ harder at school.
If you had told me, I ___ helped.

modules.title: Past Perfect Continuous — Oldindan o'tgan davomiy zamon
modules.theory: Past Perfect Continuous (Past Perfect Continuous) 1. Yasalishi: S + had been + V-ing • Darak: She had been waiting for an hour when the bus finally came. • Inkor: They hadn't been paying attention. • So'roq: Had you been working long before you took a break? 2. Qo'llanilishi: ① O'tmishdagi bir nuqtagacha davom etgan jarayon (davomiylik urg'ulanadi): His eyes were red because he had been crying. ② O'tmishdagi harakatdan oldin uzoq davom etgan jarayon: We had been driving for six hours before we found a hotel. 3. Signal so'zlar: for, since, all day, how long, before, when 4. Past Perfect bilan farqi: • Past Perfect Continuous — jarayon: She had been cooking for hours. (uzoq davom etgani muhim) • Past Perfect — natija/tugallanish: She had cooked dinner by 7 pm. (tayyorlangani muhim) • Miqdor bilan Past Perfect: He had written three letters before lunch. 5. State fe'llar bilan PPC bo'lmaydi: I had known her for years. (NOT: had been knowing) 6. Zamonlar zanjiri (bitta gapda): hozirgacha: have been · o'tmish nuqtagacha: had been By the time he turned 30, he had been playing football for 15 years.
modules.theory_oral: Past Perfect Continuous — o'tmishdagi bir voqeadan oldin uzoq davom etgan jarayonni ko'rsatadi. Yasalishi: had been va fe'lning ing shakli. Signal so'zlar: for, since, all day, before. Masalan: His eyes were red because he had been crying — ko'zlari qizargan, chunki u undan oldin uzoq yig'lagan edi.

exercises.question: She was exhausted because she ___ all day.
exercises.explanation: O'tmishdagi holatdan (was exhausted) oldingi uzoq jarayon → Past Perfect Continuous.

exercises.question: By the time we arrived, they ___ for two hours.
exercises.explanation: 'By the time' + o'tmish + davomiylik (for two hours) → had been waiting.

exercises.question: The ground was wet because it (rain) ___ all night.
exercises.explanation: Natija o'tmishda, sabab undan oldingi uzoq jarayon → had been raining.

exercises.question: He ___ three chapters before he took a break.
exercises.explanation: Miqdor (three chapters) aytilganda jarayon emas, natija → Past Perfect: had written.

exercises.question: Her eyes were red. ___ ?
exercises.explanation: Ko'rinib turgan o'tmishdagi sabab → PPC so'rog'i: Had she been crying?

exercises.question: I ___ him for years before we finally became friends.
exercises.explanation: 'Know' — state fe'l, PPC bilan ishlatilmaydi → Past Perfect: had known.

exercises.question: They (drive) ___ for six hours before they found a hotel.
exercises.explanation: Oldingi uzoq jarayon → had been driving.

exercises.question: How long ___ at the company before she was promoted?
exercises.explanation: 'How long' + o'tmishdagi nuqtagacha davomiylik → had she been working.

exercises.question: We ___ dinner when the lights went out.
exercises.explanation: Chiroq o'chishidan oldin davom etayotgan jarayon → had been preparing.

exercises.question: Qaysi gap TO'G'RI?
options: He had been studying English for five years before he moved to London.
He had been knowing her for five years.
He has been finishing the work before we came.
He had study English before he moved.
exercises.explanation: B: state fe'l PPC bo'lmaydi; C: zamonlar mos emas; D: had + V3 kerak.

modules.title: Reported Speech — Egitilgan nutq
modules.theory: Reported Speech (Indirect Speech) — birovning gapini qayta aytib berish. 1. Zamon siljishi (backshift): Bir qadam orqaga: • Present Simple → Past Simple: "I work hard." → He said he worked hard. • Present Continuous → Past Continuous: "I am reading." → She said she was reading. • Present Perfect → Past Perfect: "I have seen it." → He said he had seen it. • Past Simple → Past Perfect: "I went." → She said she had gone. • will → would: "I will help." → He said he would help. • can → could · may → might · must → had to 2. Olmosh va payt ko'rsatkichlari o'zgaradi: I → he/she · my → his/her · we → they now → then · today → that day · tomorrow → the next day · yesterday → the day before here → there · this → that 3. So'roq gaplar: • Umumiy so'roq → if / whether: "Do you like tea?" → He asked if I liked tea. • Maxsus so'roq → so'roq so'zi saqlanadi, to'g'ri so'z tartibi (subject + verb): "Where do you live?" → She asked where I lived. ⚠️ where did I live emas! 4. Buyruq va iltimos: to + V1 / not to + V1: "Open the window." → He told me to open the window. "Don't be late." → She asked us not to be late. 5. Reporting verbs: say → said · tell + kishiga → told me · ask → asked · advise, warn, promise, explain
modules.theory_oral: Reported Speech — birovning gapini qayta aytib berish. Qoida: zamoni bir qadam orqaga siljiydi, olmoshlar va payt ko'rsatkichlari o'zgaradi. So'roq gaplarda to'g'ri so'z tartibi saqlanadi, buyruqlar esa to infinitiv bilan beriladi.

exercises.question: "I am very busy," she said. → She said she ___ very busy.
"I will call you tomorrow," he said. → He said he ___ me the next day.
exercises.explanation: will → would; tomorrow → the next day.

exercises.question: "Where do you live?" → She asked me where I ___ .
exercises.explanation: So'roq so'zi saqlanadi, so'z tartibi to'g'ri (subject + verb), zamon siljiydi.

exercises.question: "Do you speak English?" → He asked ___ English.
exercises.explanation: Umumiy so'roq → if/whether + to'g'ri so'z tartibi.

exercises.question: "Don't touch it!" → She told me ___ it.
"I have finished my work," he said. → He said he ___ his work. (finish — Past Perfect yozing)
exercises.explanation: Present Perfect → Past Perfect: had finished.

exercises.question: "I saw her yesterday," he said. → He said he ___ her the day before.
exercises.explanation: Past Simple → Past Perfect: had seen.

exercises.question: "You must leave now," she said. → She said I ___ leave then.
"Can you help me?" → She asked if ___ help her.
exercises.explanation: can → could; so'z tartibi to'g'ri: I could (could I emas).

exercises.question: Qaysi gap TO'G'RI?
options: He said that he was tired.
He said that he is tired yesterday.
He told that he was tired.
He asked me where did I live.
exercises.explanation: 'Tell' dan keyin shaxs kerak (told ME); so'roqda 'where did I' — xato tartib.

exercises.question: "Please open the door," she said. → She asked me ___ the door.
"We are going home today," they said. → They said they ___ home that day.
exercises.explanation: Present Continuous → Past Continuous: were going.

modules.title: Passive Voice in all tenses — Majhul nisbat (barcha zamonlarda)
modules.theory: Passive Voice — majhul nisbat (barcha zamonlarda) Formula: be (kerakli zamonda) + V3 Ishni KIM qilgani muhim bo'lmaganda yoki bajaruvchi noma'lum bo'lganda ishlatiladi. 1. Zamonlar jadvali: • Present Simple: Letters are delivered every day. • Present Continuous: The house is being painted now. • Present Perfect: The work has been finished. • Present Perfect Continuous: ishlatilmaydi (juda og'ir) • Past Simple: The bridge was built in 1900. • Past Continuous: Dinner was being cooked when I arrived. • Past Perfect: The report had been written before the meeting. • Future Simple: The results will be announced tomorrow. • Future Perfect: The project will have been completed by June. • Modals: It must be done. This can be fixed. 2. Bajaruvchini ko'rsatish: by + agent The novel was written by Chingiz Aitmatov. 3. Ikki to'ldiruvchili fe'llar (berish/aitish): They gave him a prize. → He was given a prize. / A prize was given to him. 4. Rasmiy uslubda Passive (markaziy iboralar): • It is said that... — Aytilishicha... • It is believed that... — Ishonilishicha... • He is known to be... — U ... ekanligi ma'lum 5. Tipik xato: 'be' fe'lini tushirib qoldirish: The house built in 1990. → The house was built in 1990.
modules.theory_oral: Passive Voice — ishning bajaruvchisi emas, o'zi muhim bo'lganda ishlatiladi. Formula: be fe'li kerakli zamonda va fe'lning uchinchi shakli. Eng ko'p uchraydigan xato — be fe'lini tushirib qoldirish. Rasmiy ingliz tilida It is said that, It is believed that kabi qoliplar juda ko'p ishlatiladi.

exercises.question: The Mona Lisa ___ by Leonardo da Vinci.
exercises.explanation: O'tmishdagi bajarilgan ish + bajaruvchi (by) → Past Simple Passive: was painted.

exercises.question: A new hospital ___ in our city right now.
exercises.explanation: 'Right now' — hozir davom etayotgan → Present Continuous Passive.

exercises.question: The results (announce) ___ tomorrow. (Future Simple Passive)
exercises.explanation: Future Simple Passive: will be + V3.

exercises.question: By the time we arrived, the room ___ .
exercises.explanation: Kelishimizdan oldin tugallangan → Past Perfect Passive: had been cleaned.

exercises.question: This task ___ before Friday. (majburiyat + passive)
exercises.explanation: Modal + be + V3: must be done.

exercises.question: The project ___ by next month.
exercises.explanation: 'By next month' + kelajakdagi tugallanish → Future Perfect Passive.

exercises.question: They gave him a medal. → He ___ a medal.
exercises.explanation: Ikki to'ldiruvchili fe'l: He was given a medal.

exercises.question: Dinner (cook) ___ when the guests arrived. (Past Continuous Passive)
exercises.explanation: O'tmishda davom etayotgan jarayon + passive → was being cooked.

exercises.question: ___ that the company will expand next year.
exercises.explanation: Rasmiy qolip: It is said that... — Aytilishicha...

exercises.question: English ___ all over the world.
exercises.explanation: Umumiy fakt + bajaruvchi muhim emas → Present Simple Passive: is spoken.

exercises.question: The report ___ yet — we are still working on it.
exercises.explanation: 'Yet' → Present Perfect Passive inkor: hasn't been finished.

exercises.question: Qaysi gap TO'G'RI?
exercises.explanation: Passive = be + V3 (sent). B: 'was' yo'q; C: send emas sent; D: yesterday bilan Present bo'lmaydi.

modules.title: Inversion & Advanced structures
modules.theory: Inversion — odatdagi so'z tartibi o'zgaradi (rasmiy/adabiy uslub). Not only ___ late, but he also forgot the documents. → was he Seldom / Rarely / Never + yordamchi fe'l + subject By next year, she will have worked here for a decade. (Future Perfect)
modules.theory_oral: Inversion — Not only, Seldom kabi so'zlar bilan boshlanganda yordamchi fe'l subjectdan oldin keladi. Future Perfect — kelajakda ma'lum vaqtgacha tugagan ish: will have + V3.

exercises.question: Not only ___ late, but he also forgot the documents.
By next year, she ___ here for a decade.
'Ambiguous' so'zi ma'nosi:
Seldom ___ such kindness.
By 2030, scientists ___ (find) a solution.
Not until midnight ___ the truth.
Only then ___ understand the problem.
Never ___ (I / see) such chaos.
By the time you arrive, we ___ dinner.

modules.title: Advanced Vocabulary
modules.theory: Yuqori darajadagi so'zlar: • Ambiguous — ikki xil talqin qilinadigan • Exacerbate — muammoni kuchaytirish • Meticulous — juda ehtiyotkor va aniq • Ubiquitous — hamma joyda mavjud
modules.theory_oral: Advanced vocabulary — noaniq, kuchaytirmoq, juda diqqatli, hamma joyda uchraydigan kabi so'zlarni o'rganamiz. Ular yozma va akademik nutqda ko'p uchraydi.

exercises.question: 'To exacerbate a problem' — bu:
'Meticulous' odam qanday ishlaydi?
'Ubiquitous' so'zining ma'nosi:
'To postpone' means:
'Generous' person is:
Antonym of 'increase':
'Reliable' means:
'To make something better' verb: i___e
'Achieve a goal' means:
A meticulous worker is:

modules.title: Barcha 12 zamon — Yakuniy takrorlash (Master Review)
modules.theory: Ingliz tilidagi 12 zamonning to'liq jadvali PRESENT (Hozirgi) • Simple: V1 / V1+s → She works. — odat, fakt • Continuous: am/is/are + V-ing → She is working. — hozir jarayonda • Perfect: have/has + V3 → She has worked. — natija, tajriba • Perfect Continuous: have/has been + V-ing → She has been working. — davomiylik PAST (O'tgan) • Simple: V2 → She worked. — tugagan o'tmish • Continuous: was/were + V-ing → She was working. — o'tmishda jarayonda • Perfect: had + V3 → She had worked. — o'tmishdan oldinroq • Perfect Continuous: had been + V-ing → She had been working. — o'tmish nuqtagacha davomiylik FUTURE (Kelasi) • Simple: will + V1 → She will work. — va'da, qaror • Continuous: will be + V-ing → She will be working. — kelajakda jarayonda • Perfect: will have + V3 → She will have worked. — nuqtagacha tugallanadi • Perfect Continuous: will have been + V-ing → She will have been working. — nuqtagacha davomiylik Zamonni tanlash algoritmi: 1. Harakat qachon? (hozir / o'tmish / kelajak) 2. Jarayonmi, faktmi, natijami yoki davomiylikmi? 3. Signal so'zlar: every day (Simple) · now (Continuous) · already/just/yet (Perfect) · for/since/lately (Perfect Continuous) · by/by the time (Perfect zamonlar)
modules.theory_oral: Ingliz tilida o'n ikkita zamon bor: har birida Simple, Continuous, Perfect va Perfect Continuous shakllari mavjud. Zamonni tanlash uchun ikki savol bering: harakat qachon sodir bo'lmoqda va u jarayonmi, faktmi, natijami yoki davomiylikmi. Signal so'zlar to'g'ri zamonga yetaklaydi.

exercises.question: Look! It ___ outside.
exercises.explanation: 'Look!' — hozir ko'z oldimizdagi jarayon → Present Continuous.

exercises.question: Water ___ at 100 degrees Celsius.
I ___ my keys — I can't open the door.
exercises.explanation: Hozirga ta'sir qiluvchi natija → Present Perfect.

exercises.question: She ___ in this school since 2018.
exercises.explanation: 'Since 2018' — hozirgacha davom etayotgan jarayon → Present Perfect Continuous.

exercises.question: While I ___ dinner, the phone rang.
exercises.explanation: Uzoq jarayon ichida qisqa voqea → Past Continuous + Past Simple.

exercises.question: By 2030 they ___ the new airport.
This time next week I ___ on the beach.
exercises.explanation: 'This time next week' — aniq nuqtada jarayon → Future Continuous.

exercises.question: He (work) ___ here for ten years before he retired.
exercises.explanation: O'tmishdagi nuqtagacha davomiylik → Past Perfect Continuous.

exercises.question: When we got to the party, most guests ___ already ___ .
My brother ___ football every Saturday.
Don't disturb him — he ___ for his exams all morning and still has two subjects.
exercises.explanation: Ertalabdan beri davom etayotgan jarayon → Present Perfect Continuous.

exercises.question: Shakespeare ___ 37 plays and 154 sonnets.
exercises.explanation: Tarixiy, tugallangan fakt (muallif vafot etgan) → Past Simple.
